industries.description: Output and primary inputs by input-output industry group (IOIG), 2023-24 financial year (5209.0.55.001 Table 5, industry by industry flow table, direct allocation of competing imports; employment from Table 20). gva is value added at basic prices as published (= coe + gos_mi + other_taxes_on_production). TOT = total industry uses (employment summed over IOIGs). Weights for Layer B: wage bill coe/TOT.coe, value added gva/TOT.gva.

ioig_anzsic.description: IOIG to ANZSIC 2006 class concordance as published by the ABS with the input-output methodology ('Industry and Product Concordance Tables', sheet 'IOIG(2022) to ANZSIC06'), one row per IOIG x class (basis 'published'). Where the tables publish an IOIG that the concordance splits (1205 'Wine, spirits and tobacco' in 2023-24, the concordance's 1203 and 1204), rows for it are added with a 'derived' basis, so every IOIG in the tables maps to classes. Class 6711 maps to two IOIGs (imputed and actual rent) in the published concordance.
